result.title: AutoNovo: Agentic Program Search Discovers Transferable Nucleic Acid Design Algorithms
result.comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: Agentic AI for Biological Discovery
result.summary: In-silico optimization of nucleic acids relies on predictive oracles that imperfectly capture biological function, so sequences optimized against one model may exploit model-specific artifacts and fail to generalize to independent models. Recent studies have shown that not all designers generalize equally well to independent models. In this work, we use agentic program search to iteratively propose, execute, evaluate, and revise code for nucleic-acid designers. We describe the successful strategies used to prompt the search. AutoNovo designers achieved the best observed mean among the evaluated methods on 3/3 DNA-design tasks in terms of in-silico performance, and 6/6 transfer tasks in terms of independent models. The designers come from a family of discovered nucleic acid designers rather than a single universal best designer. We plan to release the resulting designers. These results are the first steps in creating nucleic acid designers that maximize cross-model generalization, and thus improving the odds that in-silico designed sequences reflect real biology.

AI.brief_summary: AutoNovo 用 agentic program search 迭代地提出、执行、评估并修订核酸设计器代码，在 3/3 DNA 设计任务和 6/6 跨模型迁移任务上取得所评估方法中最佳均值，并指出最优策略来自一族设计器而非单一通用设计器。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「提出—执行—评估—修订」的程序搜索把发现的设计器直接放在独立模型上做迁移评价，可能为 LVR 推理策略或工作区的搜索式发现与跨骨干泛化评估提供类比线索，可供核查。
